mapper.insert: insert into fact_card_vector_index ( fact_card_id, card_id, card_type, answer_shape, model_profile_id, embedding_dimensions, index_version, content_hash, embedding, updated_at ) values ( #{record.factCardId}, #{record.cardId}, #{record.cardType}, #{record.answerShape}, #{record.modelProfileId}, #{record.embeddingDimensions}, #{record.indexVersion}, #{record.contentHash}, cast(#{vectorLiteral} as ${vectorTypeName}), #{record.updatedAt} ) on conflict (fact_card_id) do update set card_id = excluded.card_id, card_type = excluded.card_type, answer_shape = excluded.answer_shape, model_profile_id = excluded.model_profile_id, embedding_dimensions = excluded.embedding_dimensions, index_version = excluded.index_version, content_hash = excluded.content_hash, embedding = excluded.embedding, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: select fact_card_id, card_id, card_type, answer_shape, model_profile_id, embedding_dimensions, index_version, content_hash, embedding::text as embedding, updated_at from fact_card_vector_index where fact_card_id = #{factCardId}
mapper.update: alter table fact_card_vector_index alter column embedding type ${vectorTypeName}(${targetDimensions})
create index if not exists ${indexName} on fact_card_vector_index using hnsw (embedding ${opClass})
create index if not exists ${indexName} on fact_card_vector_index using ivfflat (embedding ${opClass}) with (lists = 100)
mapper.select: select format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = current_schema() and c.relname = 'fact_card_vector_index' and a.attname = 'embedding' and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
select updated_at from fact_card_vector_index order by updated_at desc limit 1

select 'FACT_CARD' as evidence_type, fc.source_id, fc.card_id, fc.card_id as concept_id, fc.title, concat_ws(E'\n\n', fc.claim, fc.items_json::text, fc.evidence_text) as content, jsonb_build_object( 'factCardId', fc.id, 'cardId', fc.card_id, 'sourceFileId', fc.source_file_id, 'cardType', fc.card_type, 'answerShape', fc.answer_shape, 'confidence', fc.confidence, 'sourceChunkIds', fc.source_chunk_ids, 'articleIds', fc.article_ids )::text as metadata_json, fc.review_status, case when sf.file_path is null or sf.file_path = '' then array[]::text[] else array[sf.file_path]::text[] end as source_paths, 1 - (vector_index.embedding ${distanceOperator} cast(#{vectorLiteral} as ${vectorTypeName})) as score from fact_card_vector_index vector_index join fact_cards fc on fc.id = vector_index.fact_card_id left join source_files sf on sf.id = fc.source_file_id order by vector_index.embedding ${distanceOperator} cast(#{vectorLiteral} as ${vectorTypeName}), fc.updated_at desc limit #{limit}
select amname from pg_am where amname in ('hnsw','ivfflat') order by case amname when 'hnsw' then 0 else 1 end limit 1
select opcnamespace::regnamespace || '.vector_cosine_ops' from pg_opclass where opcname = 'vector_cosine_ops' order by oid asc limit 1
